facts.fact: The finance and gender ministries confirmed in a joint notice that 15,825 old-age grants were suspended because beneficiary names were unverified in the National Population Registry System, so the grant beneficiary list is checked against the population registry.
A gender ministry spokesperson said the ministry is planning to incorporate its system with that of the Ministry of Home Affairs for improved reporting of deaths.

systems.owner: Ministry of Gender Equality and Child Welfare
Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security

note: Dates are the month of the 7 June 2026 article; it dates the joint notice to the Wednesday of that week.

facts.fact: The Ministry's activity page lists MoUs for data integration with GIPF, SSC, the tax system, IFMS and the Veteran Affairs System, and the integration of the ISAS module into the Integrated Beneficiary Registry, and gives the activity as Complete with the system piloted by June 2022.
The page says a central information management system was developed holding all social grant beneficiaries, to remove duplication, with the activity at 100 percent and Complete.

facts.fact: Namibia's instant payment network, operated by Instant Payments Namibia (a Bank of Namibia subsidiary), processed its first live government grant payments, with Bank Windhoek disbursing a batch to Marginalised Beneficiaries on 17 June 2026 and Letshego Bank Namibia certified to receive grant payments.

note: G2P payment volumes through the instant payment system are not tied to a social protection registry or programme link.
